identity.customerDescription: Upload Aadhaar, PAN, or another ID. We read the document with OCR — the name you enter must match both your registered name and the name printed on the ID.
identity.instructions: Upload a clear photo (JPEG/PNG preferred) of your Aadhaar, PAN, or other ID. Enter the name exactly as printed. We OCR the file and verify that name appears on the document and matches your registered name. Upload is compulsory before go-live.

subscriptionEnd.title: End subscription
subscriptionEnd.description: Ending requires confirmation from both customer and distributor. A settlement invoice covers unbilled deliveries from the last bill (or start) through the last delivered date.
subscriptionEnd.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you ending this subscription?
subscriptionEnd.requestDescription: The other party must confirm. After both confirm, deliveries stop and a settlement invoice is issued.
subscriptionEnd.requestSent: End request sent. Waiting for the other party.
subscriptionEnd.pendingBanner: End request pending — both parties must confirm.
subscriptionEnd.confirmDescription: This will close the subscription and issue the settlement invoice for delivered, unbilled milk.
subscriptionEnd.rejected: End request rejected. Subscription remains active.
subscriptionEnd.endedHint: Your previous subscription is closed. Choose a distributor to start a new subscription — history is not transferred.
subscriptionEnd.noSettlementNeeded: No unbilled deliveries — no settlement invoice was needed.
